transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. I'm here because, well, the main thing is I just keep getting pulled off track by every little sound or thought. 

Like, I’ll be trying to work on a job application, and then a car goes by outside, or my phone lights up, or some random idea just pops into my head. And before I even notice it, I'm off doing something else entirely and the application is just sitting there. It's making it really hard to get anything done.
Did these attention and distraction problems start when you were a child?

Yeah, definitely. Even back in, um, elementary school, my teachers were always moving my seat around. I was always talking out of turn and forgetting to bring my homework in. And when I actually did the work, like the worksheets they gave us, I'd just rush right through them and make a bunch of careless mistakes. So yeah, it's been going on for a long time.
